subject.title: fix(agents): tighten bash-tools schema fields from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should `exec.yieldMs` become integer-only despite the current number-valued schema, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105560 remain the single owner for the overlapping process pagination fields?
rationale: Integer pagination follows discrete line/count semantics, but integer-only `yieldMs` is a compatibility choice rather than a clearly established existing contract, while two open PRs currently compete for the process fields.

options.title: Canonicalize and narrow
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105560 as the process pagination fix and remove `yieldMs` unless its integer-only contract is approved separately.

options.title: Adopt the combined change
options.body: Approve integer-only `yieldMs`, reconcile the competing process PR, align documentation, and require production-schema proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve number inputs
options.body: Keep the existing numeric contracts if fractional normalization is intentional and close the tightening proposals.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize and narrow
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105560 as the process pagination fix and remove `yieldMs` unless its integer-only contract is approved separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns a model-visible core agent-tool contract spanning exec behavior and public documentation.
